reason: Implementation correction to allocate country GDP once across the fixed source-study issuer universe. Prior code reallocated full GDP within each cohort and arm, giving each same-country phase full GDP mass regardless of its issuer count.
correct_rule: Unit GDP weight GDP(country,g-1)/number_of_source_study_issuers_in_country. Cohort mass is sum treated unit weights. At constant GDP, same-country cohort weights are proportional to eligible treated counts.
